## Checks

- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` pass
- [ ] Behavior changes come with a new or updated test
- [ ] No secrets, keys or private files in the diff
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits and are signed
- [ ] Changes that need a real key say which model and firmware they were tested on
